name: Website Privacy Notice
metaDescription: Learn how Cybersentinels Consulting collects, uses, shares, protects and retains personal information submitted through this website.

blocks.text: This Privacy Notice explains how [FULL LEGAL ENTITY NAME], trading as Cybersentinels Consulting (“Cybersentinels,” “we,” “us” or “our”), handles personal information when you visit [WEBSITE DOMAIN], contact us, subscribe to communications, apply for an opportunity or otherwise interact with our website.

This notice applies to the website activities described below. A separate privacy notice or contract may apply when we process personal information while delivering services to a client, acting on a client’s instructions, recruiting employees or managing another relationship.

sections.heading: 2. Who Is Responsible for Your Information?

blocks.text: The organization responsible for the processing described in this notice is:

items: Legal entity: [FULL LEGAL ENTITY NAME]
Registered or principal office: [OFFICIAL OFFICE ADDRESS]
Registration or licence number, if required: [NUMBER OR REMOVE]
Privacy email: [PRIVACY EMAIL ADDRESS]
Telephone: [OFFICIAL TELEPHONE NUMBER]
Data Protection Officer or privacy contact, if applicable: [CONTACT OR REMOVE]
EEA or UK representative, if required: [REPRESENTATIVE DETAILS OR REMOVE]

blocks.text: Information You Provide

items: Identity and professional details, such as your name, job title, employer and country or region
Contact details, such as business email address and telephone number
Inquiry information, including service interests, timeline, message and communication preferences
Subscription information and marketing preferences
Recruitment information, such as résumé or CV, work history, qualifications, portfolio links, location and application communications
Information you provide during calls, meetings, events, surveys or correspondence
Any other information you choose to submit to us

blocks.text: Information Collected Through the Website

items: Device and browser information, such as device type, operating system, browser type and language
Network and usage information, such as IP address, approximate location derived from IP, referral source, pages viewed, timestamps and interactions
Security and diagnostic information, such as logs, error events, suspected abuse and form-submission metadata
Cookie, consent and similar-technology information as described in the Cookie Policy

blocks.text: Information from Other Sources

We may receive professional contact or business information from an employer, colleague, event organizer, referral partner, public professional source, recruitment platform, service provider or another person who introduces you to us. Where required, we will provide additional information about that collection.

items: Respond to inquiries and communicate about requested services
Understand requirements and prepare discussions, scopes or proposals
Manage subscriptions, events and marketing communications
Process applications and communicate about recruitment
Operate, secure, troubleshoot and improve the website
Detect, prevent and investigate fraud, abuse, attacks and other security events
Maintain business records and manage professional relationships
Comply with applicable law, lawful requests, legal claims and contractual obligations
Protect our rights, systems, personnel, clients and other users
Complete a transaction or organizational change, subject to appropriate safeguards

blocks.text: The legal ground or permitted use depends on the jurisdiction and processing context. Where applicable, we may rely on:

items: Your consent, including for optional cookies or selected communications where consent is required
Steps requested before entering a contract or performance of a contract
Our legitimate interests or those of another organization, balanced against applicable rights and interests
Compliance with a legal obligation
Protection of legal rights, security or vital interests where applicable
Another ground or permitted use recognized by applicable law

blocks.text: You may withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent. Withdrawal does not affect processing already carried out lawfully before withdrawal.

We use strictly necessary technologies required to operate and secure the website. We will use analytics, preference, advertising or other optional technologies only as described in the Cookie Policy and, where required, after you make a valid choice through the consent tool.
[CONFIRM WHETHER OPTIONAL COOKIES, TAGS, EMBEDS, SESSION REPLAY, ADVERTISING OR CROSS-SITE TECHNOLOGIES ARE USED. ALIGN THIS SECTION WITH THE FINAL COOKIE INVENTORY.]
We may share personal information only as reasonably necessary with:

items: Approved website hosting, email, communications, analytics, security, recruitment, customer-relationship and business-service providers
Professional advisers such as lawyers, accountants, auditors and insurers where appropriate
Authorized personnel, contractors or group entities with a need to know
A client, partner or other organization when you ask us to coordinate with it or the relationship requires it
Authorities, courts or other parties when required by law or reasonably necessary to protect rights, safety, systems or legal claims
A buyer, investor or successor in connection with a proposed or completed restructuring, financing, merger, acquisition or transfer, subject to appropriate controls

blocks.text: We do not state that we sell personal information. [COUNSEL MUST CONFIRM WHETHER ANY IMPLEMENTED ADVERTISING OR ANALYTICS ACTIVITY COULD BE REGARDED AS A SALE, SHARING OR TARGETED ADVERTISING UNDER AN APPLICABLE LAW.]
Our website, personnel and service providers may process information in India, the UAE and other countries. Those countries may have data-protection rules different from those in your location.

Where applicable law requires a transfer mechanism or additional safeguards, we will use the relevant approved measure and complete any required assessment. [IDENTIFY ACTUAL HOSTING AND RECIPIENT COUNTRIES AND INSERT THE APPLICABLE TRANSFER MECHANISM BEFORE PUBLICATION.]

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose collected, applicable legal and contractual requirements, security, dispute resolution and the establishment or defence of claims. We then delete, anonymize or securely isolate it as appropriate.

items: Inquiry and proposal records: [RETENTION PERIOD AND TRIGGER]
Marketing and subscription records: [RETENTION PERIOD AND SUPPRESSION APPROACH]
Recruitment applications: [RETENTION PERIOD BY JURISDICTION]
Website security and technical logs: [RETENTION PERIOD]
Cookie and consent records: [RETENTION PERIOD]
Legal-hold exception: retained while a documented hold or claim requires it

blocks.text: We use administrative, technical and organizational measures designed to protect personal information according to its nature and risk. No transmission, website, storage system or security control can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Do not submit passwords, credentials, sensitive vulnerability details, government identifiers, payment-card information or other unnecessary sensitive information through general website forms.

Depending on your location and the processing, you may have rights to receive information, obtain access, correct or update information, request deletion or erasure, restrict or object to processing, withdraw consent, request portability, nominate another person, seek review of certain automated decisions, or raise a grievance or complaint.

Rights are subject to applicable conditions, exceptions and identity verification. To submit a request, contact [PRIVACY EMAIL ADDRESS]. Please describe the request and your relationship with us. We will not ask for more identity information than reasonably necessary.
Complaints and Grievances

Please contact us first at [GRIEVANCE OR PRIVACY EMAIL] so we can review your concern. You may also have the right to complain to the data-protection or supervisory authority applicable to you. [INSERT REQUIRED INDIA GRIEVANCE PROCESS, RESPONSE PERIOD AND DATA PROTECTION BOARD INFORMATION WHEN APPLICABLE PROVISIONS ARE IN FORCE; INSERT RELEVANT EEA, UK OR UAE AUTHORITY INFORMATION IF REQUIRED.]

You may unsubscribe from marketing emails using the link in the message or by contacting [MARKETING OR PRIVACY EMAIL]. We may retain a minimal suppression record so we can respect the request. Service, security, legal or transactional communications are managed separately where applicable.

This website is intended for business users and is not directed to children. We do not knowingly seek to collect personal information from children through general website forms. If you believe a child has submitted information, contact [PRIVACY EMAIL ADDRESS]. [COUNSEL MUST CONFIRM THE APPLICABLE AGE THRESHOLDS AND WHETHER ANY SERVICE OR CONTENT CHANGES THIS POSITION.]

We do not intend to make decisions producing legal or similarly significant effects about website visitors solely through automated processing. [CONFIRM RECRUITMENT, LEAD-SCORING, FRAUD AND MARKETING TOOLS BEFORE RETAINING THIS STATEMENT.]
Our website may link to external sites or services. Their operators are responsible for their own privacy practices. Review the relevant notice before providing information.

We may update this notice to reflect changes in our practices, technology or legal requirements. We will post the updated version and revise the “Last updated” date. Where required, we will provide additional notice or request consent.
